Messages.Author: Athenethor
Messages.Body:
Hello,

I have another question about Rotschreck. What will happen in the next
combat?

Basilia is blocking another vampire and this vampire play a maneuver to set
long range. In the strike declaration, Basilia strikes with her hand
(aggravated), and the other vampire strikes with a sacrament of carnage.
Before the strike resolution, the Basilia's controller try to play
Rotschreck.

Could he play it?
How is resolve the combat?

Thanks for your knowledge.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Athenethor wrote:
> Basilia is blocking another vampire and this vampire play a maneuver to set
> long range. In the strike declaration, Basilia strikes with her hand
> (aggravated), and the other vampire strikes with a sacrament of carnage.
> Before the strike resolution, the Basilia's controller try to play
> Rotschreck.
>
> Could he play it?

No. Rotschreck requires that the minion attempt to use aggravated damage
"against a vampire". At long range, the hand strike is not capable of
being "against the opposing minion". [RTR 28-SEP-1998]

> How is resolve the combat?

Moot.
